JPEG Q91/Q92/Q93 quantization tables and derived coefficient rankings

Sampling factor used for derivation: 4:2:0 (2x2,1x1,1x1)
Source encoder: ImageMagick/libjpeg standard tables
Tie-break for equal averages: lower Q92 value, then lower JPEG zigzag slot
